topic: Is Selenic free to use as the product name of a Windows desktop AI coding assistant (formerly MoonAliza/Moonzila): software products and companies named Selenic; Selenic open-source projects and package names and web domains; Selenic registered trademarks in software and developer tools
notes: Run 2 (follow-up, 3 pages, about 3 credits; the project stands at 22 of 30 credits before it). Run 1 left U-04 and U-07 without a decisive capture: Mercurial's hgweb refused every Firecrawl engine for the 2005 PKG-INFO, the wiki URL found by the planning search (with a trailing slash) answered 404, and the Microsoft Store search page rendered no results (a partial capture). The replacements were status-checked with a planning curl on 2026-10-12 (HTTP status and, for hg.py, a count of the word selenic), which is not evidence: the wiki page without the trailing slash answers 200; the Store's own JSON search endpoint behind apps.microsoft.com answers 200; hg.py is Mercurial's source in a GitHub mirror whose description (run 1, the GitHub repository search) says it mirrors selenic.com/repo/hg. The EUIPO and WIPO registers take POST searches from JavaScript applications and are not attempted; U-03 is KNOWN-UNKNOWN with the manual search.
